प्रतुद् प्र-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते,
-तोत्तुम्, to strike at, strike, cut, pierce: Caus. -तो-
दयति, -यितुम्, to pierce; to push on, instigate.

प्र-तुद, अस्, m. ‘pecker,’ epithet of a class
of birds (including the falcon, hawk, owl, parrot,
crow, raven, peacock, &c.); an instrument for
pricking.

प्रतुष् प्र-तुष्, cl. 4. P. -तुष्यति, -तोष्टुम्,
to delight in, take pleasure in (with inst.): Caus. P.
-तोषयति, -यितुम्, to give pleasure, gratify.

प्र-तुष्टि, इस्, f. gratifying, satisfying, satisfaction.
—प्रतुष्टि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving satisfaction.

प्र-तुष्टुषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to begin,
desirous of commencing.

प्रतूणी प्र-तूणी, f. a kind of nervous
disease (in which pain is felt to extend itself from
the rectum and organs of generation towards the
bowels; in the disease called तूणी the pain takes an
opposite direction, whence perhaps प्र-तूणी is an
incorrect form for प्रति-तूणी).

प्रतूर्ण प्र-तूर्ण, प्र-तूर्त, &c. See under
प्र-त्वर्, p. 629, col. 1.
प्र-तूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, fleet.
प्र-तूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hastening, speeding.

प्रतूर्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word प्र-
तूर्त.

प्र-तूर्ति, इस्, f., Ved. rapid or violent motion,
undulatory motion, haste, speed; (Sāy.) = प्रकृष्ट-
हिंसन, excessive violence; (इस्, इस्, इ), hastening,
rapid, violent.
